## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta5

### Restore live mower artwork after the beta4 performance refactor
- Fix a beta4 regression where `mower_icon: auto` could leave the mower SVG hidden even though live position, heading, trail and mower state were still updating normally.
- Read the mower model directly from the mower entity metadata when available, including Navimower 0.4.3-beta46+, without restoring the expensive browser-side device-registry scan to the normal dashboard hot path.
- While model metadata is not available yet, use the existing H2 artwork as a safe generic fallback instead of returning no artwork and hiding the mower.
- When the real model arrives later, invalidate the fallback artwork and rerender with the model-specific icon automatically.

### Regression coverage
- Add an isolated upgrade test proving unresolved Auto artwork remains drawable and later H215 metadata replaces the fallback without any device-registry discovery dependency.

Scheduler, current-cycle trail and beta4 performance behavior are otherwise unchanged.
